summary: A product variant selection system for buy boxes featuring image thumbnails and text buttons for selecting size, color, and other product options.

Text button variants for size selection
Collapsible grid with show more functionality on desktop

longDescription:
## Purpose

The Basic Variant Selection component enables customers to choose product variants such as size, color, or other attributes directly within the buy box on product detail pages. It provides an intuitive interface that helps customers make informed purchasing decisions by clearly displaying available options.

## Use Cases

- Selecting product variants using color swatches or image thumbnails
- Choosing sizes via text buttons with clear active and unavailable states
- Viewing unavailable variant combinations as disabled with explanatory tooltips
- Navigating through many variants using mobile slider or desktop collapsible grid

## Design Rationale

The component uses a combination of visual swatches and text buttons to accommodate different variant types. Unavailable combinations are shown as disabled rather than hidden when multiple variant dimensions exist, helping customers understand product availability across different combinations. The responsive design adapts navigation patterns for optimal usability on both mobile and desktop devices.
shortDescription: The Basic Variant Selection enables customers to choose product variants such as size, color, or other attributes directly within the buy box. It uses visual swatches and text buttons to accommodate different variant types. Unavailable combinations are shown as disabled with tooltips when multiple variant dimensions exist, helping customers understand product availability. The responsive design adapts navigation patterns—mobile slider for overflow and desktop collapsible grid—for optimal usability across devices.
